title: Cocaine worth 1,002 lbs found hidden in rebar truck at California border
summary_full: Federal officers seized more than $20 million in cocaine hidden beneath the floorboards of a commercial truck carrying 269 bundles of rebar at California’s Calexico border crossing, arresting the driver after finding 366 packages of narcotics.
